selected.prompt:
Style: exact white opaque canvas; flat 2D technical drawing, no gradients, textures, shadows, pseudo text, numbers or letters. Rounded rectangle modules (6 px corner radius), neutral dark wires #556170. Blue priority #7188A3 with fill #E5EAF0 for the main mechanism; muted green #829C8B fill #E8EEE9 only secondary sources; muted yellow #B4A16F fill #F1ECDD for position/selection; muted red #A7787D fill #F0E5E6 only losses/errors, not the generic output; purple #9588A5 only a further category if needed. Most area white, fills pale and uniform. Draw all shapes, actual mechanism glyphs, matrices and connectors, leave labels empty for real-font typography.
Redesign a textbook positional-encoding calculation using three equally spaced panels, landscape 2048 x 1024. Reference1 shows desired rich mechanistic three-panel organization, reference2 a related network. Panel1: TOP three small round-corner token slots; below a rounded lookup box with blank label zone; below a 3-row 4-column embedding matrix. First and third rows have identical pale blue emphasis. Panel2: TOP three small position slots; below one compact rounded sine/cosine operation; below a 3-row 4-column position matrix, green pale emphasis. Panel3: a small rounded 3x4 mini matrix copy at upper left of panel and another at upper right supply an empty circular addition operator; operator points down to the full 3-row 4-column result matrix. Result first and third rows differ in pale blue shading. Thin dashed gray vertical separators between panels. Plenty of room above/below matrix for exact real-font names, within all cells for numbers, above all three input slots for token/position labels. No decorative icon. Visually rich but each calculation honest.
No text of any kind. Put essential numeric grids at prescribed row/column counts; keep geometry regular and clear. All labels will be added separately with actual fonts.
